newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH TO PUBLISH CORRECTED JULY CPI DATA.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH TO PUBLISH CORRECTED JULY CPI DATA.

text.p: The Dutch Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Tuesday it would publish corrected July consumer price index (CPI) data at 1230 GMT.
The CBS said the July CPI data published on Friday was based on an incorrect calculation of the annual increase in housing rents that occurs on July 1 each year.
It said this error led only to limited changes in the CPI data but that it would publish corrected data.
The original data showed a 0.6-percent month-on-month increase and a year-on-year rise of 2.4 pct.
